title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.0.3
body_markdown:
### Added

* Allow to define a custom shortcut to accept completions. TAB is still the default shortcut.
* Allow to define a custom shortcut to hide the completions in the editor. ESC is still the default shortcut.

### Fixed

* The IDE was incorrectly prompting to re-authenticate with GitHub.
body_html:
Added

  • Allow to define a custom shortcut to accept completions. TAB is still the default shortcut.
  • Allow to define a custom shortcut to hide the completions in the editor. ESC is still the default shortcut.

Fixed

  • The IDE was incorrectly prompting to re-authenticate with GitHub.
